key.name: candidate-page-size
key.description: How many candidates to show per page in the lookup panel. Recommended values: 3, 5, 9, or 12. Out-of-range values are clamped to [3, 12].

key.name: commit-on-space
key.description: When enabled, the spacebar commits the highlighted candidate. When disabled, Space inserts a literal space and the candidate must be committed with Return.

key.name: cluster-aliases-enabled
key.description: Enables consonant-cluster shortcut aliases such as 'j' = 'ky', 'ch' = 'kj', 'gy' = 'ky+s', 'sh' = 'shy'. Toggling rebuilds the parser; takes effect within ~1 second of the change.

key.name: lm-prune-margin
key.description: Maximum log-probability gap a candidate may trail the best ranked candidate before being dropped. Larger = more permissive panel; 0 = no LM pruning.

key.name: anchor-commit-threshold
key.description: Roman-input length past which the engine locks a previously rendered top candidate as committed and stops re-parsing it.

key.name: burmese-punctuation-enabled
key.description: When enabled, '.' / ',' typed after a Burmese surface insert the corresponding Myanmar punctuation marks ('။' / '၊').

key.name: number-measure-words-enabled
key.description: Offer Burmese measure-word completions when a number is typed (e.g. '၂၀၂၄ ခုနှစ်' for '2024').

key.name: learning-enabled
key.description: When enabled, committed selections are recorded in the on-disk history database and re-ranked higher next time the same reading is typed. Off disables both reads and writes.
